Hotels & Places

The hotels and cities at the center of the research, with uncertain associations kept distinct from verified ones.

Zürich · Hotel

Savoy-Baur en Ville

  • Previously verifiedCLAIM-SAVOY-1911

    Earlier research found a 1911 advertisement identifying S. H. Gottlieb as director of Baur en Ville or Savoy.

    Sources: SRC-003
  • Verified directCLAIM-BAUR-BIBLOS-OCR

    A 1914 contemporary travel guide describes S. H. Gottlieb as Direktor of the Savoy-Hotel Baur en Ville in Zürich.

    Sources: SRC-004, SRC-019
  • Verified directCLAIM-BAUR-POSTCARD

    A cataloged promotional postcard associates the wording 'Direktion S.H. Gottlieb' with Baur en Ville.

    Sources: SRC-002
  • Verified directCLAIM-SAVOY-1922

    A 1922 Swiss travel guide lists S. H. Gottlieb as director of Savoy-Baur en Ville in Zürich.

    Sources: SRC-001
  • Conflicting evidenceCLAIM-SAVOY-SECONDARY-DUFFING-1909-1910

    A secondary Savoy history assigns Hermann Duffing a management period from 1909 to 1910.

    Sources: SRC-018
  • Conflicting evidenceCLAIM-SAVOY-SECONDARY-GOTTLIEB-1910-1918

    A secondary Savoy history assigns a management period from 1910 to 1918 to 'I. Gottlieb'.

    Sources: SRC-018
  • Conflicting evidenceCLAIM-SAVOY-SECONDARY-GIGER-1918-1926

    A secondary Savoy history assigns Fritz Giger a management period from 1918 to 1926.

    Sources: SRC-018
  • Catalog verifiedCLAIM-SAVOY-CENTENARY-1938

    Hans Schulthess's 64-page illustrated Savoy centenary history was published in Zürich in 1938 and is cataloged by the Wolfsonian.

    Sources: SRC-010
  • Research leadCLAIM-LASSMANN-CROSS-HOTEL-HYPOTHESIS

    It remains unresolved whether the Jakob Lassmann associated in secondary material with Baur en Ville was the same Jakob Lassmann whose family was connected with the Hotel Messmer property.

    Sources: SRC-018, SRC-021, SRC-026

Caution: The management chronology contains an unresolved conflict between direct 1922 evidence and a secondary timeline.

Zürich · Hotel

Grand Hotel Victoria

  • Verified directCLAIM-VICTORIA-1922-KUMMER-WENGER

    The same 1922 travel guide that lists S. H. Gottlieb at Savoy-Baur en Ville lists Zürich's Hotel Victoria under A. Kummer-Wenger.

    Sources: SRC-001
  • Needs recheckCLAIM-GRAND-VICTORIA-1924

    Earlier research identified a possible 1924 connection between S. H. Gottlieb and Zürich's Grand Hotel Victoria.

    Sources: SRC-006

Caution: A. Kummer-Wenger is listed with the hotel in 1922. The separate 1924 Gottlieb connection remains a needs-recheck lead; Gottlieb's role is not established.

Baden-Baden · Hotel

Hotel Messmer

  • Indexed leadCLAIM-MESSMER-1929

    Marketplace metadata indicates that a 1929 Hotel Messmer advertisement associated with Gottlieb exists.

    Sources: SRC-007
  • Official secondaryCLAIM-MESSMER-CLOSED-SINCE-1930

    An official Baden-Baden historical account reports that Hotel Messmer had been closed since 1930.

    Sources: SRC-021
  • Verified directCLAIM-SYLVESTER-BADEN-HOTELIER-1931

    A contemporary trade newspaper dated 20 March 1931 identifies Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb in Baden-Baden as a hotelier.

    Sources: SRC-020
  • Verified directCLAIM-MESSMER-LESSEE-1931

    The 20 March 1931 entry describes Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb as Pächter—lessee or operator—of Hotel Meßmer in Baden-Baden.

    Sources: SRC-020
  • Verified directCLAIM-GOTTLIEB-BANKRUPTCY-AUFHEBUNG-1931

    By 20 March 1931, a bankruptcy proceeding concerning hotelier Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb appeared in the Aufhebungen section for the Baden-Baden court district.

    Sources: SRC-020
  • Previously verifiedCLAIM-MESSMER-C1932

    Earlier research found a circa 1932 telephone-directory entry naming S. H. Gottlieb as Inhaber of Hotel Messmer.

    Sources: SRC-008
  • Previously verifiedCLAIM-MESSMER-1934

    Earlier research found a 1934 telephone-directory association between Hotel Messmer and S. H. Gottlieb.

    Sources: SRC-009
  • Official secondaryCLAIM-MESSMER-LASSMANN-PROPERTY

    An official Baden-Baden historical account associates the Hotel Messmer property with the Lassmann property complex.

    Sources: SRC-021
  • Catalog verifiedCLAIM-MESSMER-RESTITUTION-FILE-1949-1952

    A cataloged Staatsarchiv Freiburg restitution file concerning Hotel Messmer spans 1949–1952 and is described as containing material about the Jakob Lassmann heirs.

    Sources: SRC-022
  • Research leadCLAIM-LASSMANN-CROSS-HOTEL-HYPOTHESIS

    It remains unresolved whether the Jakob Lassmann associated in secondary material with Baur en Ville was the same Jakob Lassmann whose family was connected with the Hotel Messmer property.

    Sources: SRC-018, SRC-021, SRC-026

Caution: Gottlieb is directly documented as Pächter—lessee or operator—in 1931, not as proven property owner. The reported 1930 closure and later directory references remain in conflict.
